sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.subtitle: Everything you need to know about weekly mocks, mentorship, and our referral network.

items.question: How does the team use my mock marks and resume?
items.answer: Our internal team reviews your weekly mock test scores and analyzes your performance trends. We then update and optimize your resume to highlight your strengths, packaging both into a verified candidate dossier that we refer directly to fast-hiring HR teams and agencies.

items.question: What does the ₹5,000 subscription fee cover?
items.answer: The fee covers full access to our weekly mock test portal, live mentorship sessions, expert resume curation, performance tracking, and active candidate dossier management. Direct HR and agency referral coordination is included as a complimentary value-added service.

items.question: How fast are the partner companies hiring?
items.answer: Our fast-hiring partner network consists of 450+ HR agencies and corporate enterprises with active, ongoing recruitment cycles across tech, operations, and general management roles.

items.question: Are job placements guaranteed?
items.answer: No platform can legally guarantee a job offer. The subscription guarantees the full delivery of our preparation services, mock testing, resume optimization, and active employer referrals. Final hiring decisions and selections are made entirely by the corporate recruiters based on interview performance.

dashboard_overview.team_note: Our placement team is actively reviewing your latest mock marks for upcoming corporate batch referrals.

support_and_trust.legal_disclaimer: Disclaimer: CareerLoop (`careerloop.co.in`) is an independent career acceleration and skill preparation platform, not a government agency or guaranteed employment provider. The subscription fee covers mock testing, mentorship, resume curation, and dossier management services. Employer referrals and interview scheduling are complimentary assistance benefits. Final hiring selections and compensation packages rest solely with respective corporate employers.
